title: Doctor (MBBS)
summary: Diagnoses and treats patients. The MBBS degree is the foundation every medical specialisation builds on.

criteria.label: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English passed

milestones.title: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English in class 11 and 12
milestones.detail: Biotechnology can stand in for Biology. Under NMC's 2023 decision these subjects can also be passed as additional subjects after class 12 from a recognised board, so another stream does not close medicine for good.

milestones.title: Sit NEET (UG)
milestones.detail: You can sit it while appearing in class 12, but you must pass class 12 before the first round of counselling. One paper of 180 questions for 720 marks: Physics 180, Chemistry 180, Biology 360. A correct answer earns 4 marks and a wrong one loses 1. There is no upper age limit.

milestones.title: Qualify, then win a seat through counselling
milestones.detail: An MBBS seat needs at least the 50th percentile in NEET (40th for SC, ST and OBC candidates; 45th for unreserved PwBD candidates). The MCC allots the 15% All India Quota and seats at AIIMS, JIPMER, central and deemed universities; each state's counselling authority allots the rest.

milestones.title: MBBS, ending in a one-year internship
milestones.detail: After the degree comes a compulsory one-year internship, and registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council. Both are what NEET-PG asks for if you go on to specialise.
